name: Yahoo Pulse
tagline: A read-only daily brief on the tickers you follow, with charts and news
description: Keeps an eye on a personal list of stock symbols and hands back a plain briefing. It pulls quotes from a free charting endpoint, gathers the headlines tied to each symbol, and renders price-and-volume images you can scan in seconds. It reports only: it places no orders and gives no investment advice.
author: Thomas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
